clues: This text-only architecture activates just 23 billion parameters per token out of 501 billion across 52 layers.
Its midtraining phase expanded its effective context window up to 1 million tokens.
During reinforcement learning across 10,500 GPUs, it autonomously learned to invoke optical character recognition APIs.
It scored 80.9 on SWE-bench Verified and 80.1 on Terminal Bench v2.1.
It was built using auxiliary-loss-free load balancing and SandwichNorm to maintain training stability.
This open-weight mixture-of-experts model was debuted by Reflection AI for coding and agentic workloads.
